original_title: Jan Klimke contributes to OGC Workshop on "Expanding GeoWeb to an Internet of Things"
original_content_full:
Jan Klimke contributes to OGC Workshop on "Expanding GeoWeb to an Internet of Things"

Our research group member Jan Klimke is contributing to the Workshop "Expanding GeoWeb to an Internet of Things" by giving a talk on "Integrating 3D Data in Service-based Visualization Systems". The Workshop is organized by the Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) as part of its Mobile Internet initiative. It is held on 23/24 May, 2011, and is co-located to the 2nd International Conference on Computing for Geospatial Research & Applications, COM.Geo 2011, in Washington DC.
